description: Get full detail for a specific concentrated-liquidity LP strategy by ID: includes APY per range width over the last 24 hours, each range anchored on the current price (narrower range = higher APY but more rebalancing cost/risk), the 7-day average APY at the default range in the yield field, pool info, and configuration. For basic (constant-product) pools, use strategy_apy_7d from read_strategy_list. Use read_strategy_list to discover strategy IDs. All APY values are decimal fractions (1.0 = 100%, 0.05 = 5%).
name: read_strategy_info
